title: Keep recovery-test transports and clocks attached after reload
outcome: Unclassified-refusal recovery tests observe the transport and clock actually installed in the reloaded state, so their no-producer-send and retry assertions detect real regressions.
acceptance: Each affected recovery fixture reinstalls the recording transport and, where timing is asserted, the scripted budget clock after load_state; assertions observe the active adapter after any second session setup.

Behavioral coverage proves that presentation repair after reload does not route or send a producer record and that advancing the installed clock controls the intended retry boundary. Existing mirror, rollback, missing-directory, deleted-owner and no-redirection checks retain their observable coverage.
Focused checks cover the affected helper callers; the exact landing input passes the required full gate and independent review pair.
